title: The Jonas Brothers’ Comeback Continues With ‘Camp Rock 3’ Release: Here’s Where to Watch Online Free
summary: Attention millennials: Get your latest dose of nostalgia by tuning into the highly anticipated sequel starting Thursday (Aug. 13).
contentText:

The  Camp Rock  comeback is finally here, and anticipation is building for the franchise’s long-awaited return.  Camp Rock 3  reunites Joe Jonas, Nick Jonas and Kevin Jonas as Shane, Nate and Jason, bringing Connect 3 back to the screen and giving patient, longtime fans what they deserve.

The brothers are joined by a younger cast led by Liamani Segura as Sage and Malachi Barton as Fletch, who are ready to carry the torch in the next installment. Only one song, “ One Beat Away ,” has been released ahead of the movie premiere, with a 17-song album available once the film is out.

Executive producer Demi Lovato is also returning as Mitchie Torres for a cameo , making the reunion even more meaningful. She joined the Jonas Brothers at the Los Angeles premiere, where she posed with Joe Jonas on the red carpet.

For die-hard fans, the movie premieres on the Disney Channel on Thursday (Aug. 13) before arriving on Disney+ the following day.

At a Glance: Where to Watch ‘ Camp Rock 3 ‘ Online

- Date: Broadcasts on Thursday, Aug. 13; Streams on Friday, Aug. 14

- Start Time: 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT

- Streaming Platform: DirecTV , Sling TV , Hulu + Live TV , Disney+

How To Watch ‘Camp Rock 3’ Online

If you don’t have access to Disney Channel via a traditional cable or satellite TV, you can watch on streaming platforms that carry the channel, like DirecTV , Sling TV and others.

DirecTV

Get 5-Day Free Trial

Watch Camp Rock 3 on DirecTV . The platform’s entry-level plan is the “Entertainment” package, which features more than 90 live channels, including Disney Channel, as well as Hulu and Disney+ bundle (with ads) and ESPN Unlimited. The streaming platform is offering $30 off for the first month for $59.99 for the first month and $89.99 per month afterward. The plan includes over 150 MyFree DirectTV channels.

Sling TV

Get Sling Orange

Sling Blue

You can watch Camp Rock 3 via Sling TV . The platform’s Sling Orange plan includes access to 30 live channels, including Disney Channel, ESPN and Freeform. Prices start at $45.99 monthly, or you can purchase a three-month prepay price of $114.99, then $45.99 monthly. Customers can even add HBO Max, Paramount+ with SHOWTIME and STARZ to their plan too. As long as you have a internet connection, Sling TV can be watched anywhere in the U.S.

Hulu + Live TV

Get 3-day free trial

Hulu + Live TV comes with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited at no additional cost.

If you don’t have a  Hulu + Live TV subscription, the streamer offers a  free trial  that’ll get you your first three days free to access Disney Channel. Once the free trial is over, you’ll be charged the regular subscription fee, which starts at $89.99 per month. For even more content, Hulu + Live TV bundles with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited at no extra cost to watch even more exclusive and original sporting events and programming.

'Camp Rock 3'

Get Disney+

Get Disney+ and Hulu plans starting at $9.99 per month.

Camp Rock 3 appears on Disney+ from Friday (Aug. 14) onward. The streaming platform offers several plans for customers wanting more than just Disney content. Plans start at $11.99 per month for the Disney+ and Hulu Bundle , which includes Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, Nat Geo, Hulu Originals and FX. Customers can choose the six-month pay plan upfront.

On the higher end, customers can opt for the Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Unlimited Bundle Premium for $44.99 per month, which includes all of ESPN’s networks, option to download videos and other features.

Camp Rock 3  picks up the franchise 18 years after  Camp Rock  debuted in 2008 and 16 years after  Camp Rock 2: The Final Jam in 2010. The long-awaited sequel comes after years of fans revisiting the originals and wondering if the story would ever continue. Now, the wait is just about over.
